During the quarter, grader Priya Anand completed 406 reads across 336 hours. This represents an average of 1.2 reads per hour. The recorded workload reflects the activity completed during the review period and provides the basis for the quality assessment below.

## Quality

A sample of 40 reads was checked as part of the review. Agreement was 70.0, indicating the level of consistency identified through the checking process. The results have been recorded for the quarter and do not require further action at this stage.

The review was completed by reviewer Priya Anand. As the grader and reviewer were the same person, the workload and quality information were considered together in this assessment.
